subject: [PATCH v2 2/2] mm: zswap: use stack requests for synchronous decompression

2026-10-09.patch_summary: This patch improves the performance of synchronous decompression in zswap by allowing some algorithms to use stack requests instead of heap requests. This reduces contention on a per-CPU mutex, which can lead to stalls for higher-priority loads. The change is made possible because the codecs keep their own stream locks and the per-CPU context is set up before its CPU comes online. The patch adds a function to check whether an algorithm can use stack requests and applies it to software compressors. This results in a smaller load path, but also increases the memory usage by 216 bytes for each load.
